title: Vendor master-data audit document
description: Per-vendor audit trail of res.partner + res.partner.bank field changes (scenario 3). Off the PO FK spine — built from Odoo mail-tracking. Facts + neutral fields only: no 'authorized' verdict; the LLM decides if a change is suspicious from context (who/what field/when vs payment).

changes.description: One record per tracked field change, oldest first.

payments.description: this vendor's payments across all its POs (date + amount + destination account facts only, no proximity verdict), so a change landing shortly before a payment run — or a payment landing on a recently added account — is observable to a detector without the extract itself judging it.

destination_bank_account_id.description: Which bank account this payment was sent to. Matches bank_account_additions[].bank_ref, so a detector can notice a payment landing on a non-first (account_ordinal > 1) account.

bank_account_additions.description: S3 support: this vendor's bank-account row CREATIONS (facts only; a separate array from `changes`, deliberately — an addition is not a tracked field edit, and mail_tracking_value never records the row insert itself, so this is sourced from res_partner_bank.create_date/create_uid instead). `account_ordinal` = 1 is the vendor's earliest account by create_date/id; the extract does not decide which ordinal is suspicious.
